newsitem.title: MEXICO: Mexico nabs suspect in death of drug lawyer.
newsitem.headline: Mexico nabs suspect in death of drug lawyer.

text.p: Authorities in northern Nuevo Leon state said Tuesday they have captured a suspect in the murder of prominent lawyer Agapito Garza Salinas, who was known for defending drug traffickers.
The suspect, Ramon Gumaro Garza de la Garza, confessed to the killing and fingered two agents of the Nuevo Leon State Judicial Police in the crime, authorities said.

"The accomplices of Ramon Gumaro Garza de la Garza remain at large and are sought by officials in other states of the country," the chief of Nuevo Leon's State Judicial Police, Hector Santos Saucedo, told reporters.
Nuevo Leon state, which borders Texas, is a part of the territory of the Gulf cartel, one of the major drug smuggling operations in Mexico.
Garza de la Garza, the suspect, also confessed to killing three other people whose bodies were discovered buried in a vacant lot in city of Garcia, Santos said.
Garza Salinas, the lawyer, was executed December 2 after being abducted from a Monterrey restaurant. He was the second prominent lawyer murdered in Nuevo Leon this year.
